title: Corrected estimates put microtubule decoherence near neural timescales

statements.text: Correcting Tegmark’s model to match Orch OR lengthens microtubule decoherence times to 10^-5 to 10^-4 seconds, and ordered water and actin gel could extend them to 10^-2 to 10^-1 seconds, within neurophysiological range.

Correcting Tegmark’s model to match Orch OR lengthens microtubule decoherence times to $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-4}$ seconds, and ordered water and actin gel could extend them to $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-1}$ seconds, within neurophysiological range.

sources.quote: These revisions bring microtubule decoherence into a regime in which quantum gravity can interact with neurophysiology.
